name: Nevalyashka3_1
summary: Nevalyashka3_1 is a mean reversion EA that trades against price extremes, opening positions when the price deviates significantly from a moving average or central value. It aims to capture price return-to-mean moves by entering counter-trend trades at oversold/overbought levels. The EA uses a volatility-based approach with customizable deviation thresholds for entry signals.
summary_zh: Nevalyashka3_1是一个均值回归EA，在价格偏离移动平均线或中心值显著时开仓反向交易。它通过在超卖/超买水平入场来捕捉价格回归均值的行为，采用基于波动率的偏差阈值作为入场信号。
strategy_analysis: Nevalyashka（不倒翁）策略的核心概念是均值回归，即假设价格在偏离均值后会回归到均值附近。入场条件基于价格相对于移动平均线或中心价格的偏差程度，当偏差超过设定阈值时开仓反向交易——价格过度上涨时做空，过度下跌时做多。出场条件通常采用目标获利和止损机制，也可能在价格回归到均值水平时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，策略依赖价格回归的统计特性，但连续单边行情时可能面临较大浮亏风险。整体而言，该策略适合震荡市场，在趋势市场中表现较差。
strategy_analysis_en: The Nevalyashka (Roly-Poly) strategy is fundamentally a mean reversion approach, operating on the assumption that price will revert to its mean after significant deviation. Entry conditions are based on the degree of price deviation from a moving average or central price level — when deviation exceeds a configurable threshold, a counter-trend position is opened: selling when price is excessively high and buying when excessively low. Exit conditions typically involve a target profit level and stop loss, or closing when price returns to the mean zone. Position sizing may use fixed lots or an equity-proportional method. Money management relies on the statistical tendency of price to revert, but the strategy faces significant drawdown risk during sustained trending markets. Overall, this strategy is suited for ranging markets and tends to underperform in strong trend conditions.

parameters.description_en: Lot size reduction factor after loss

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

pros: 均值回归策略在震荡市场中表现稳定，胜率较高
逆势入场提供了较好的入场价格，降低了交易成本
参数可调性强，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境优化设置
具有止损和止盈机制，单笔风险可控
pros_en: Mean reversion strategy performs stably in ranging markets with a relatively high win rate
Counter-trend entries provide favorable fill prices, reducing effective trading costs
Highly configurable parameters allow optimization for different instruments and market conditions
Has stop loss and take profit mechanisms, keeping per-trade risk manageable
cons: 在强趋势市场中逆势交易可能造成连续亏损和大幅浮亏
均值回归假设不总是成立，极端行情下价格可能长期不回归
缺乏市场状态识别机制，无法自动区分震荡和趋势市场
仓位管理相对简单，未考虑波动率动态调整手数
cons_en: Counter-trend trading in strong trending markets can lead to consecutive losses and large drawdowns
The mean reversion assumption does not always hold; price may stay displaced for extended periods during extreme moves
Lacks market regime detection to automatically distinguish between ranging and trending conditions
Position sizing is relatively simplistic without dynamic volatility-based lot adjustment
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在趋势市场中暂停交易或减少仓位
引入动态止损止盈机制，根据ATR等波动率指标调整止损距离和目标利润
improvements_en: Add a market regime filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to pause trading or reduce position size during trending markets
Introduce dynamic stop loss and take profit mechanisms adjusted by volatility indicators such as ATR

risk_points: 逆势交易在趋势行情中可能产生较大浮亏
均值回归策略在极端单边行情下可能连续止损
缺乏市场状态识别，无法自适应切换交易模式
risk_points_en: Counter-trend positions can generate significant floating losses during trending markets
Mean reversion strategy may suffer consecutive stop losses in extreme one-way markets
No market regime detection, unable to adaptively switch trading modes

It aims to capture price return-to-mean moves by entering counter-trend trades at oversold/overbought levels. The EA uses a volatility-based approach with customizable deviation thresholds for entry signals.
